description.content:
Allows searching for devices matching specific criteria.

> Param           | Default  | Example  | Description
> ----------------|---------------|---------------|----
> `id`            | -             | 11            | Filter by device ID-s
> `registration`  | -             | 12            | Filter by registration number. Exact match
> `serial`        | -             | 13            | Filter by serial number. Exact match
> `brand`         | -             | Tesla         | Filter by brand. Exact match
> `model`         | -             | Model S       | Filter by model. Exact match
> `version`       | -             | 100 AWD       | Filter by version. Exact match
> `year`          | -             | 2020          | Filter by year. Exact match
> `color`         | -             | red           | Filter by device color. Exact match
> `customerId`    | -             | 14            | Filter by customer ID-s
> `customerName`  | -             | Tom           | Filter by customer name. Fuzzy search
> `searchPhrase`  | -             | AWD           | Fuzzy search over fields `registration`, `serial`, `brand`, `model`, `version`, `year` and owner name.
> `limitedAccess` | -             | true          | If devices with access restrictions should be returned
> `callerAccess`  | -             | true          | If the query should return devices that are accessible to the user or those that are not accessible. Returns both by default
> `withTotalCount` | false         | true          | If total count of matched records should be returned in response header `x-total-count` 
> `pageSize`      | 20            | 100           | Allows specifying how many records per page should be returned
> `pageNr`        | 1             | 2             | Allows specifying which page should be returned for creating paginated views over the data.
> `sort`          | id            | -id           | Allows specifying in which order the rows should be returned. Supported values are: `id`, `relevance`, `custFirstname`, `custName`, `dateSoldAt`, `registration`, `serial`, `brand`, `model`, `version`, `year`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. It is possible to reverse the order by adding a `-` prefix to the sorting keyword.
>
